## PRB1.2. En route service units {#prb1.2.-en-route-service-units .Heading-2-ER}

- Italy recorded 12,425K actual service units in 2025, +5.9% compared to 2024 (11,733K).

- Actual 2025 service units were in line with the plan (12,456K).

- Actual 2025 service units are +23.7% above the actual 2019 level (10,046K).
